steps.content: At the base of the cliff below Northsnow Manor, falling snow silently buries the evidence of a recent plummet.
Xiaofeng, bored with guarding the unconscious person, catches a whiff of liquor and abandons her post for the nearby inn.
In that unguarded moment, a girl in deep purple embroidered shoes, adorned with silver bells, picks her way through the snow. She bends to scrutinize the figure lying there.
The person's pale lips and tightly shut eyes speak of a body still reeling from the fall.

Gently, she brushes the accumulating snow from the person's head and body. As she does, she uncovers a small spider clinging to the unconscious one's neck, its delicate legs twitching faintly. It lies barely alive, its body nearly snow-white except for the dark purple markings on its legs.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Oh, my precious little Seven. Look at you, all battered and bruised. Granny's heart can't take it.
The girl crouches, her fingertips stroking the little spider with tenderness. She pricks her own finger, coaxing forth a bead of blood that glows with an eerie, poisonous color.
The spider drinks, and an unearthly luminescence washes over its tiny body. It trembles back to life, nuzzling affectionately against her skin.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: ...If it weren't for that funny power this little one's got, would this granny be out here tramping through this frozen wasteland, meddling in other folks' business? Leaving that secret codex just lying around?
After feeding the little spider, the girl's gaze drifts to the unconscious person's face. Her fingertips then hover, cautious and hesitant, just above the wrist, never quite making contact.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Oh ho? Tough little cookie, aren't you? Still breathing. And this face... even prettier up close.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Last night, when those funny spikes from your body gave me such a shock, my own aches and pains settled right down afterward. What sort of power is that...?
She braces herself for the blow as she speaks. Barely able to contain her excitement and anticipation, she quickly grabs the other's wrist.
But nothing happens. Just silence. The red light she was waiting for never comes.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Well now. That's odd. Not even a flicker? It was so lively last night. What, tired itself out already?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Body too weak to wake it up? Or maybe... not enough stimulation? Do I need to... take a little nibble?
Her grip shifts to a pulse-point check. The beat is there, but faint. She probes several key points on the body, yet detects no echo of that mysterious energy.

In the falling snow, the unconscious person's eyelashes tremble, scattering tiny, crystalline flakes. His eyes slit open, though consciousness remains out of reach. Through the swirling snow mist, all he perceives is the vague, blurred silhouette of a girl.
steps.female_content: In the falling snow, the unconscious person's eyelashes tremble, scattering tiny, crystalline flakes. Her eyes slit open, though consciousness remains out of reach. Through the swirling snow mist, all she perceives is the vague, blurred silhouette of a girl.

steps.content: ...Who... are you?

A hoarse voice squeezes from his throat. The girl, seeing he's awake, tries to activate her power again, but the spikes from last night remain stubbornly inert. The effort, however, nearly knocks the barely conscious young man out cold again.
steps.female_content: A hoarse voice squeezes from her throat. The girl, seeing she's awake, tries to activate her power again, but the spikes from last night remain stubbornly inert. The effort, however, nearly knocks the barely conscious young woman out cold again.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Sigh, was last night just a fluke?
Her probing yields nothing. The girl shakes her head, disappointment evident as impatience creeps into her voice.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Just call me <color=#fb9259>Granny</color>. Look at you, head full of cotton, can't remember your own name, probably. What's the point of explaining?
He wants to ask more questions, but the dizziness from his fall leaves him too weak to speak. Instead, he can only manage to slowly raise his hand and reach forward.
steps.female_content: She wants to ask more questions, but the dizziness from her fall leaves her too weak to speak. Instead, she can only manage to slowly raise her hand and reach forward.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Don't bother with thanks. Granny just brushed some snow off. If you'd gone and kicked the bucket here, all my running around this godforsaken manor all day would've been for nothing!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: That codex those "heroes" are tearing each other apart over? It's a death trap, plain and simple. And that little girl by your side? Sharp as a blade, that one.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: But all that... you'll find out soon enough.
Before the girl can finish her explanation, the poor soul—who had scarcely opened eyes moments ago only to endure her test—finally succumbs and lets the eyelids fall shut.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Asleep again? Fine, fine. You owe Granny one now. Next time... I'll come find you to collect.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>When that time comes... don't you dare disappoint me.</color>
